title: Origin story: Maui
description: Maui was the demigod trickster-hero of Polynesia, born premature and cast into the sea, raised to become mankind's great benefactor. He fished up the islands with his grandmother's jawbone hook, slowed the sun with ropes to lengthen the day, and stole fire — dying only when he sought immortality itself.
